chunks: Yunus, from some of his companions, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
If the owned servant steals from his masters, his hand is not cut off; but if he steals from other than his masters, it is cut off.

key_terms.اَلْمَمْلُوكُ: the owned servant or slave under the authority of masters
key_terms.قُطِعَ: the hadd punishment of amputation is carried out
key_terms.لَمْ يُقْطَعْ: the hadd punishment of amputation is not carried out on him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a mamluk steals from his own masters versus from other people?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning theft committed by a mamluk. It distinguishes between stealing from his own masters and stealing from others, with the hadd penalty applying in the latter case and not in the former.
